title: Kino, musiqa va kitoblar
goal_uz: Dars oxirida kino, musiqa va kitob janrlarini nomlaysiz, “I think” va “in my opinion” bilan fikringizni aytasiz, biror asarni tavsiya qilasiz va syujetni uch-to‘rt oddiy gapda so‘zlab bera olasiz.

scenes.title: Kino, musiqa va kitoblar haqida gapiramiz
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Yigirmanchi darsga xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan darsda tabiat, hayvonlar va atrof-muhit haqida gaplashdik. Bugun hammaga yoqadigan mavzu: kino, musiqa va kitoblar. Siz janrlarning nomlarini o‘rganasiz, fikringizni “I think” va “in my opinion” bilan aytasiz, biror narsani tavsiya qilasiz va syujetni oddiy gaplar bilan so‘zlab berasiz. Dars oxirida bir daqiqalik tavsiyangiz tayyor bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we talk about films, music and books. You will give opinions, recommend things and tell a simple story.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun kino, musiqa va kitoblar haqida gaplashamiz. Fikr bildirasiz, tavsiya berasiz va oddiy hikoya aytib berasiz.

scenes.title: Kino janrlari

examples.t: I love comedies.
She hates horror films.

scenes.say_native: Birinchi gap janrlar haqida. Janr ingliz tilida “genre”, kino esa “film”, amerikaliklar “movie” ham deyishadi. Eng ko‘p uchraydigan janrlar: “comedy” — kulgili film, “drama” — jiddiy hayotiy film, “horror” — qo‘rqinchli film, “action” — jang va quvlashlar, “romance” — sevgi haqida, “thriller” — hayajonli, tarang film.
scenes.say: Comedy, drama, horror, action, romance, thriller. I like comedies. She hates horror films.
scenes.say_uz: Komediya, drama, dahshat, jangari, romantika, triller. Men komediyalarni yaxshi ko‘raman. U dahshatli filmlarni yoqtirmaydi.

scenes.title: Janrlarni takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Endi takrorlang. Diqqat: “comedy” so‘zida urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda: KO-mi-di. “Thriller” so‘zidagi “th” tilni tishlar orasiga qo‘yib aytiladi, “t” yoki “s” emas. “Horror” da “h” yengil nafas bilan, “x” emas. Har bir so‘zni ikki marta ayting, avval sekin, keyin tabiiy tezlikda.
scenes.say: Comedy. Drama. Horror. Action. Romance. Thriller.
scenes.say_uz: Komediya. Drama. Dahshat. Jangari. Romantika. Triller.

scenes.title: Boshqa kino turlari

examples.t: I watched a documentary about whales.
examples.uz: Men kitlar haqida hujjatli film ko‘rdim.

examples.t: Children love animated films.

scenes.say_native: Yana to‘rtta kerakli so‘z. “Documentary” — hujjatli film, u haqiqiy voqealar haqida. “Cartoon” yoki “animated film” — multfilm. “Science fiction” — ilmiy fantastika, qisqacha “sci-fi” deyiladi, kosmos va kelajak haqida. “Fantasy” — sehr, ajdarlar va afsonaviy olam haqida. Esda tuting: “fiction”
scenes.say: A documentary shows real life. A cartoon is an animated film. Sci-fi is about the future. Fantasy has magic.
scenes.say_uz: Hujjatli film haqiqiy hayotni ko‘rsatadi. Multfilm - animatsion film. Fantastika kelajak haqida. Fentezida sehr bor.

scenes.title: Musiqa janrlari

examples.t: I listen to pop music in the car.
My father likes classical music.

scenes.say_native: Endi musiqa. Janrlar deyarli o‘zbekchadagi bilan bir xil: “pop”, “rock”, “jazz”, “rap”. “Classical music” — klassik musiqa. “Folk music” — xalq musiqasi, o‘zbekcha “xalq qo‘shiqlari”ga to‘g‘ri keladi. Musiqani “tinglash” uchun “listen to” deymiz va “to” ni tushirib qoldirmang: “I listen to music”.
scenes.say: Pop, rock, jazz, classical, folk, rap. I listen to music every day. My favourite singer is very famous.
scenes.say_uz: Pop, rok, jazz, klassik, xalq, rep. Men har kuni musiqa tinglayman. Mening sevimli xonandam juda mashhur.

scenes.title: Kitob turlari

examples.t: I'm reading a long novel.
She prefers non-fiction.

scenes.say_native: Kitoblar. “Novel” — roman. “Short story” — qisqa hikoya. “Poetry” — she’riyat, “poem” esa bitta she’r. “Biography” — biror odamning hayoti haqidagi kitob. Hamma kitoblar ikki katta guruhga bo‘linadi: “fiction” — to‘qima, ya’ni yozuvchi o‘ylab topgan hikoya, va “non-fiction” — haqiqiy faktlar haqidagi kitob. Yozuvchi — “writer”
scenes.say: A novel is a long story. A biography is the story of a real life. Fiction is made up. Non-fiction is real.
scenes.say_uz: Roman - uzun hikoya. Biografiya - haqiqiy hayot hikoyasi. Badiiy asar to‘qilgan. Hujjatli kitob haqiqiy.

scenes.title: Nimani yoqtirasiz?
board: What kind of films do you like?

examples.t: What kind of music do you like?
I like rock and a little jazz.
examples.uz: Men rok va ozgina jazzni yoqtiraman.

scenes.say_native: Suhbatni boshlash uchun eng foydali savol: “What kind of films do you like?” ya’ni qanday filmlarni yoqtirasiz? “Kind of” bu yerda “tur” degani. Javob oddiy: “I like” va janr nomi ko‘plikda. Agar juda yoqsa, “I love”, yoqmasa “I don’t like” yoki “I hate”.
scenes.say: What kind of films do you like? I like comedies and sci-fi. What about you? I love rock and a little jazz.
scenes.say_uz: Qanday filmlarni yoqtirasiz? Men komediya va fantastikani yoqtiraman. Siz-chi? Men rok va ozgina jazzni yaxshi ko‘raman.

scenes.title: So‘z tartibi xatosi
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida “komediyani juda yaxshi ko‘raman” deymiz, ya’ni “juda” fe’ldan oldin keladi. Shuning uchun ko‘pchilik “I like very much comedy” deb xato qiladi. Ingliz tilida fe’l bilan to‘ldiruvchi orasiga “very much” qo‘yilmaydi. To‘g‘ri: “I like comedies very much” yoki “very much” ni oxirga olib o‘tish.
scenes.say: I like comedies very much. I really like comedies.
scenes.say_uz: Men komediyalarni juda yaxshi ko‘raman. Men komediyalarni chindan yoqtiraman.

scenes.title: Janrni toping
board: 3) A funny story, you laugh a lot
scenes.say_native: Uchta tavsifni o‘qing va qaysi janr ekanini ayting. Birinchisi: ajdarlar, sehr va qahramon. Ikkinchisi: Afrikadagi haqiqiy hayvonlar haqidagi film. Uchinchisi: kulgili voqea, siz juda ko‘p kulasiz. Har biriga javob bering: “It’s a ...”. Bunda sehr, haqiqiy hayvonlar va kulgi so‘zlariga e’tibor bering, ular janrni oson ko‘rsatadi.
scenes.say: Dragons, magic and a hero. Real animals in Africa. A funny story, you laugh a lot. What genre is each one?
scenes.say_uz: Ajdarlar, sehr va qahramon. Afrikadagi haqiqiy hayvonlar. Kulgili hikoya, siz juda ko‘p kulasiz. Har biri qaysi janr?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchisi — fantasy, chunki sehr va ajdarlar. Ikkinchisi — documentary, chunki hayvonlar haqiqiy. Uchinchisi — comedy, kulgili voqea. E’tibor bering, “It’s a” dan keyin janr nomi bitta, ya’ni birlikda keladi va oldidan “a” turadi. Ammo “fantasy film” desangiz ham to‘g‘ri, bu ikki so‘z birga janrni bildiradi.
scenes.say: One. It's a fantasy film. Two. It's a documentary. Three. It's a comedy.
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Bu fentezi film. Ikki. Bu hujjatli film. Uch. Bu komediya.

scenes.title: Fikr bildirish: I think

examples.t: I think the film is funny.
I don't think the book is boring.

scenes.say_native: Fikr bildirishning eng oddiy yo‘li — “I think”, ya’ni menimcha. Keyin oddiy gap keladi: “I think the film is funny”. Muhim qoida: inkorni “think” ga qo‘yamiz. “Menimcha, bu zerikarli emas” — “I don’t think it’s boring”. “I think it isn’t boring” deyish ham mumkin, lekin tabiiyroq variant birinchisi.
scenes.say: I think the film is funny. I think the music is great. I don't think the book is boring.
scenes.say_uz: Menimcha, film kulgili. Menimcha, musiqa zo‘r. Menimcha, kitob zerikarli emas.

scenes.title: In my opinion
board: In my opinion, it's the best film.

examples.t: In my opinion, the ending is sad.
In my opinion, rock is better than pop.

scenes.say_native: “In my opinion” — mening fikrimcha. U “I think” ga o‘xshaydi, lekin yozma nutqda va rasmiyroq gapda ko‘proq ishlatiladi. Odatda gap boshida turadi va undan keyin vergul qo‘yiladi. Ikkalasini birga ishlatmang: “In my opinion I think” — ortiqcha. Bittasini tanlang. “In my opinion” da “opinion”
scenes.say: In my opinion, the ending is sad. In my opinion, rock is better than pop.
scenes.say_uz: Mening fikrimcha, tugashi qayg‘uli. Mening fikrimcha, rok popdan yaxshi.

scenes.title: Fikrni ifodalovchi sifatlar

examples.t: The film was exciting.
The book is moving.

scenes.say_native: Fikringiz aniq chiqishi uchun sifatlar kerak. Ijobiy: “great”, “brilliant”, “excellent” — a’lo. “Funny” — kulgili, “exciting” — hayajonli, “moving” — ta’sirli, yurakka tegadigan. Salbiy: “boring” — zerikarli, “awful” — dahshatli yomon, “scary” — qo‘rqinchli. “Good” va “bad” so‘zlarini hamma ishlatadi, lekin “brilliant”
scenes.say: Great, brilliant, funny, exciting, moving. Boring, awful, scary. The film was exciting.
scenes.say_uz: Zo‘r, a’lo, kulgili, hayajonli, ta’sirli. Zerikarli, dahshatli yomon, qo‘rqinchli. Film hayajonli edi.

scenes.title: Boring va bored
scenes.say_native: Juda ko‘p uchraydigan xato. “-ing” bilan tugaydigan sifat narsaning xususiyatini bildiradi: film zerikarli — “the film is boring”. “-ed” bilan tugaydigan sifat bizning his-tuyg‘uimizni bildiradi: men zerikdim — “I’m bored”. Agar “I’m boring” desangiz, “men zerikarli odamman” bo‘lib qoladi.
scenes.say: The film is boring, so I am bored. The story is interesting, so I am interested.
scenes.say_uz: Film zerikarli, shuning uchun men zerikdim. Hikoya qiziqarli, shuning uchun men qiziqdim.

scenes.title: Tanlang
scenes.say_native: Qavs ichidan to‘g‘ri sifatni tanlang. Birinchi gap: kitob qiziqarli. Ikkinchi gap: men bu filmda zerikyapman. Uchinchi gap: tugashi kutilmagan, ajablantiradigan. Qoidani eslang: narsa uchun “-ing”, bizning his-tuyg‘uimiz uchun “-ed”. Gaplarni to‘liq baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: The book is interesting or interested? I'm bored or boring in this film? The ending is surprising or surprised?
scenes.say_uz: Kitob qiziqarli yoki qiziqqan? Men bu filmda zerikdim yoki zerikarliman? Tugashi ajablantiradimi yoki ajablangan?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “The book is interesting” — kitobning xususiyati, shuning uchun “-ing”. Ikkinchi: “I’m bored in this film” — bu mening his-tuyg‘um, shuning uchun “-ed”. Uchinchi: “The ending is surprising” — tugash ajablantiradi, “-ing”. Savol berishning oddiy usuli: kim yoki nima shu holatni keltirib chiqaryapti?
scenes.say: One. The book is interesting. Two. I'm bored in this film. Three. The ending is surprising.
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Kitob qiziqarli. Ikki. Men bu filmda zerikyapman. Uch. Tugashi ajablantiradi.

scenes.title: Rozilik va norozilik
board: I'm not sure. / That's true, but...

examples.t: I agree with you.
I'm not sure. I think it's too long.
examples.uz: Ishonchim komil emas. Menimcha, u juda uzun.

scenes.say_native: Fikr almashishda boshqaning fikriga munosabat bildirish kerak. “I agree” — roziman. “I don’t agree” — rozi emasman. “Me too” — men ham, “me neither” — men ham emas, bu inkor gapga javob. Yumshoqroq norozilik uchun “I’m not sure” — ishonchim komil emas, yoki “That’s true, but...” — to‘g‘ri, lekin...
scenes.say: I agree with you. I don't agree. Me too. Me neither. I'm not sure. That's true, but I think it's too long.
scenes.say_uz: Men siz bilan roziman. Men rozi emasman. Men ham. Men ham emas. Ishonchim komil emas. To‘g‘ri, lekin menimcha u juda uzun.

scenes.title: Fikringizni ayting
scenes.say_native: Uchta fikrni eshiting va o‘z fikringizni bildiring. Birinchisi: superqahramon filmlari zerikarli. Ikkinchisi: klassik musiqa tinchlantiradi. Uchinchisi: kitoblar filmlardan yaxshi. Har biriga “I agree because...” yoki “I don’t agree because...” bilan javob bering. Sabab ko‘rsatish uchun “because” so‘zi kerak.
scenes.say: Superhero films are boring. Classical music is relaxing. Books are better than films. What do you think?
scenes.say_uz: Superqahramon filmlari zerikarli. Klassik musiqa tinchlantiradi. Kitoblar filmlardan yaxshi. Siz nima deb o‘ylaysiz?

scenes.title: Namuna javoblar
board: 1) I don't agree. I think they're exciting.
2) I agree. It helps me sleep.
3) I think it depends on the book.
scenes.say_native: Mana bir nechta namuna. Birinchi: “I don’t agree. I think they’re exciting.” Ikkinchi: “I agree. It helps me sleep.” Uchinchi: “I think it depends on the book” — bu kitobga bog‘liq, “it depends” juda foydali ibora. Sizning javobingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin va bu yaxshi. Muhimi: fikr, keyin sabab.
scenes.say: I don't agree. I think they're exciting. I agree. It helps me sleep. I think it depends on the book.
scenes.say_uz: Men rozi emasman. Menimcha ular hayajonli. Men roziman. U uxlashimga yordam beradi. Menimcha, bu kitobga bog‘liq.

scenes.title: Birinchi dialog: film haqida
board: A: Did you see the new film?
B: Yes! I think it's brilliant.
A: Really? I thought it was too long.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Ikki do‘st yangi film haqida gaplashyapti. Ular bir-biridan filmni ko‘rgan-ko‘rmaganini so‘raydi, fikrini aytadi, ammo fikrlari har xil. Tinglashda e’tibor bering: Ben filmni qanday baholadi va Anna nimadan shikoyat qildi? Bu dialogdan keyin sizga ikkita savol beraman.
scenes.say: Anna: Did you see the new space film, Ben? Ben: Yes! I think it's brilliant. The music is great. Anna: Really? I thought it was too long. Ben: In my opinion, it's exciting all the way. Anna: Maybe I'm just tired. Ben: Watch it again!
scenes.say_uz: Anna: Yangi kosmik filmni ko‘rdingmi, Ben? Ben: Ha! Menimcha, u a’lo. Musiqasi zo‘r. Anna: Rostdanmi? Menimcha, u juda uzun edi. Ben: Mening fikrimcha, u boshidan oxirigacha hayajonli. Anna: Balki charchagandirman. Ben: Yana ko‘r!

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
board: 1) What does Ben think of the film?
2) What is Anna's problem with it?
3) What does Ben say about the music?
scenes.say_native: Dialog bo‘yicha uchta savol. Birinchi: Ben film haqida nima deb o‘ylaydi? Ikkinchi: Annaga film nimasi bilan yoqmadi? Uchinchi: Ben musiqa haqida nima dedi? Javoblarni to‘liq gap bilan ayting, masalan: “Ben thinks...”. Fikr bildirish iboralarini topishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: What does Ben think of the film? What is Anna's problem with it? What does Ben say about the music?
scenes.say_uz: Ben film haqida nima deb o‘ylaydi? Annaning muammosi nima? Ben musiqa haqida nima deydi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) He says the music is great.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Ben filmni a’lo deb hisoblaydi, “brilliant”. Ikkinchi: Annaga film juda uzun tuyuldi, “too long”. “Too” — me’yoridan ortiq, odatda salbiy ma’noda. Uchinchi: Ben musiqa zo‘r deydi, “the music is great”. Bundan tashqari Ben “in my opinion” ni ishlatdi. “Thought”
scenes.say: He thinks it's brilliant. She thinks it's too long. He says the music is great.
scenes.say_uz: U filmni a’lo deb o‘ylaydi. U filmni juda uzun deb o‘ylaydi. U musiqa zo‘r deydi.

scenes.title: Tavsiya berish
board: You should watch / read / listen to...

examples.t: You should watch this film.
I recommend this book.
It's worth seeing.

scenes.say_native: Tavsiya berish uchun uchta yo‘l o‘rganamiz. Birinchi: “You should” va fe’l, “you should watch this film”. Ikkinchi: “I recommend” va ot, “I recommend this book”. “Recommend” so‘zida “m” ikkita, “c” bitta: re-co-mmend. Uchinchi: “It’s worth” va “-ing” shaklidagi fe’l, “it’s worth seeing” — ko‘rishga arziydi.
scenes.say: You should watch this film. I recommend this book. It's worth seeing. Have you seen it?
scenes.say_uz: Bu filmni ko‘rishingiz kerak. Bu kitobni tavsiya qilaman. Uni ko‘rishga arziydi. Siz uni ko‘rganmisiz?

scenes.title: Tavsiyaga sabab qo‘shing
board: It's perfect if you like + noun

examples.t: It's perfect if you like comedies.
You'll love it because the story is moving.

scenes.say_native: Faqat “watch it” deyish kam. Yaxshi tavsiyada sabab bo‘ladi. “It’s about” — u nima haqida: “It’s about a boy and a dog”. “It’s perfect if you like” — agar sizga shu yoqsa, aynan mos: “It’s perfect if you like comedies”. “You’ll love it because” — sizga yoqadi, chunki... Bu yerda “you’ll”
scenes.say: It's about a boy and a dog. It's perfect if you like comedies. You'll love it because the story is moving.
scenes.say_uz: U bola va it haqida. Agar komediyalarni yoqtirsangiz, u mukammal. U sizga yoqadi, chunki hikoya ta’sirli.

scenes.title: Recommend xatosi
board: ✗ I recommend you to watch it.
✓ I recommend it. / You should watch it.
scenes.say_native: Ikkita tipik xato. Birinchisi: “I recommend you to watch”. O‘zbekchada “sizga ko‘rishni tavsiya qilaman” desak, shunday tuzamiz va ingliz tiliga so‘zma-so‘z o‘tkazamiz, lekin bu noto‘g‘ri. To‘g‘risi: “I recommend watching it” yoki “I recommend it”. Ikkinchi xato: “should” dan keyin “to” ishlatish. “Should”
scenes.say: I recommend watching it. You should watch it. I recommend this book.
scenes.say_uz: Men uni ko‘rishni tavsiya qilaman. Siz uni ko‘rishingiz kerak. Men bu kitobni tavsiya qilaman.

scenes.title: Tavsiya bering
board: 3) Your teacher wants a short book.
scenes.say_native: Uchta vaziyat. Birinchi: do‘stingiz kulgili filmlarni yaxshi ko‘radi. Ikkinchi: opangiz qo‘rqinchli hikoyalarni yoqtiradi. Uchinchi: o‘qituvchingiz qisqa kitob qidiryapti. Har biriga o‘ylab, bitta tavsiya bering. Janrni aytib, “You should” yoki “I recommend” va sababni qo‘shing. Kitob yoki film nomini o‘zingiz o‘ylab toping.
scenes.say: Your friend loves funny films. Your sister likes scary stories. Your teacher wants a short book. What do you recommend?
scenes.say_uz: Do‘stingiz kulgili filmlarni yaxshi ko‘radi. Opangiz qo‘rqinchli hikoyalarni yoqtiradi. O‘qituvchingiz qisqa kitob qidiryapti. Nimani tavsiya qilasiz?

scenes.title: Namuna tavsiyalar
board: 1) You should watch a comedy. It's perfect if you want to laugh.
2) I recommend a horror story. You'll love it.
3) I recommend a short story. It's worth reading.
scenes.say_native: Namunalar. Birinchi: “You should watch a comedy, it’s perfect if you want to laugh.” Ikkinchi: “I recommend a horror story, you’ll love it.” Uchinchi: “I recommend a short story, it’s worth reading.” Siz aniq nom ham ayta olasiz, masalan, haqiqiy film yoki kitob nomi.
scenes.say: You should watch a comedy. It's perfect if you want to laugh. I recommend a horror story. It's worth reading.
scenes.say_uz: Komediya ko‘rishingiz kerak. Kulishni xohlasangiz, u mukammal. Men qo‘rqinchli hikoyani tavsiya qilaman. O‘qishga arziydi.

scenes.title: Syujetni oddiy so‘zlar bilan aytish

examples.t: The film is about a young girl.
It's set in London.

scenes.say_native: Syujet — plot, ya’ni voqealar zanjiri. Uni qisqa aytish uchun ketma-ket uch ibora yetadi. “It’s about” — u kim yoki nima haqida. “The main character is” — bosh qahramon kim. “It’s set in” — voqea qayerda bo‘ladi. Asosiy qoida: syujetni hozirgi oddiy zamonda aytamiz, hatto film o‘tmishda bo‘lgan bo‘lsa ham.
scenes.say: It's about a young girl. The main character is called Mia. It's set in London.
scenes.say_uz: U yosh qiz haqida. Bosh qahramon Mia deb ataladi. Voqea Londonda bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Hodisalar ketma-ketligi

examples.t: At the beginning, Mia loses her bag.
In the end, she finds it.

scenes.say_native: Voqealarni tartib bilan aytish uchun bog‘lovchi so‘zlar kerak. Boshlash uchun “At the beginning” yoki “First”. Davom ettirish uchun “Then” va “After that”. Tugatish uchun “In the end”. Hozirgi oddiy zamonda uchinchi shaxs birligida fe’lga “-s” qo‘shamiz: “she loses”, “he finds”, “she meets”. “-s”
scenes.say: At the beginning, Mia loses her bag. Then she meets a boy. After that, he helps her. In the end, she finds it.
scenes.say_uz: Boshida Mia sumkasini yo‘qotadi. Keyin u bir bola bilan uchrashadi. Shundan so‘ng u unga yordam beradi. Oxirida u uni topadi.

scenes.title: Syujetdagi xatolar
board: ✗ The film tells about a boy.
✓ The film is about a boy.
scenes.say_native: Ikki xato. Birinchisi: “The film tells about”. O‘zbekchada “film ... haqida hikoya qiladi” desak, “tells” ishlatamiz deb o‘ylaymiz. Ingliz tilida esa “is about” deymiz: “The film is about a boy”. Ikkinchisi: uchinchi shaxs birlikda fe’lga “-s” qo‘shish: “she loses”, “he lives”.
scenes.say: The film is about a boy. She loses her bag. No spoilers, please!
scenes.say_uz: Film bir bola haqida. U sumkasini yo‘qotadi. Iltimos, tugashini aytmang!

scenes.title: Syujetni so‘zlab bering
board: 2) What happens? 3) What happens in the end?
scenes.say_native: Mashhur ertak — Zolushka. Uni uch gap bilan aytib bering. Birinchi gap: u kim haqida. Ikkinchi gap: nima bo‘ladi. Uchinchi gap: oxirida nima bo‘ladi. Esda tuting: hozirgi oddiy zamon, uchinchi shaxsda “-s” bilan va “At the beginning”, “Then”, “In the end” so‘zlari. Qiz, o‘gay ona, shahzoda va bal so‘zlari: girl, stepmother, prince, ball.
scenes.say: Tell the story of Cinderella in three sentences. Use at the beginning, then, and in the end.
scenes.say_uz: Zolushka hikoyasini uchta gapda so‘zlab bering. Boshida, keyin va oxirida so‘zlaridan foydalaning.

scenes.title: Namuna syujet
board: It's about a girl called Cinderella.
Then she goes to the ball and meets a prince.
In the end, the prince finds her.
scenes.say_native: Namuna. Birinchi gap: “It’s about a girl called Cinderella.” Ikkinchi: “Then she goes to the ball and meets a prince.” Uchinchi: “In the end, the prince finds her and they are happy.” Ko‘rdingizmi: hamma fe’llar hozirgi zamonda, “goes”, “meets”, “finds”. “Go” fe’li “goes” bo‘ladi, “es” bilan.
scenes.say: It's about a girl called Cinderella. Then she goes to the ball and meets a prince. In the end, the prince finds her.
scenes.say_uz: U Zolushka degan qiz haqida. Keyin u balga boradi va shahzoda bilan uchrashadi. Oxirida shahzoda uni topadi.

scenes.title: Ikkinchi dialog: kitob do‘konida
board: A: Can you recommend a good book?
B: What kind of books do you like?
A: I like short stories and mystery.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog — kitob do‘konida. Xaridor sotuvchidan yaxshi kitob tavsiya qilishni so‘raydi. Sotuvchi avval xaridorning didini aniqlaydi, so‘ngra tavsiya beradi. Bu dialog haqiqiy hayotda juda foydali: kitob do‘konida, kutubxonada yoki do‘stlar orasida shunday gapirasiz. Tinglang va kitobning nomi, janri va narxini eslab qoling.
scenes.say: Customer: Excuse me, can you recommend a good book? Seller: Of course. What kind of books do you like? Customer: I like mystery stories. Seller: Then I recommend The Silent House. It's about a missing girl. It's very exciting. Customer: How much is it? Seller: It's twelve pounds. Customer: I'll take it.
scenes.say_uz: Xaridor: Kechirasiz, yaxshi kitob tavsiya qila olasizmi? Sotuvchi: Albatta. Qanday kitoblarni yoqtirasiz? Xaridor: Men sirli detektiv hikoyalarni yoqtiraman. Sotuvchi: Unda “Jim uy”ni tavsiya qilaman. U yo‘qolgan qiz haqida. Juda hayajonli. Xaridor: Narxi qancha? Sotuvchi: O‘n ikki funt. Xaridor: Men uni olaman.

scenes.title: Savollar
board: 1) What kind of books does the customer like?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: xaridor qanday kitoblarni yoqtiradi? Ikkinchi: tavsiya qilingan kitob nima haqida? Uchinchi: narxi qancha? Esda tuting: sotuvchi kitobni nima uchun tavsiya qildi? Chunki xaridorning didiga mos kelgan. Javoblaringizni to‘liq gap bilan bering va suhbatdagi so‘zlarni takrorlashdan qo‘rqmang.
scenes.say: What kind of books does the customer like? What is the book about? How much is it?
scenes.say_uz: Xaridor qanday kitoblarni yoqtiradi? Kitob nima haqida? Narxi qancha?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: xaridor mystery, ya’ni sirli detektiv hikoyalarni yoqtiradi. Ikkinchi: kitob yo‘qolgan qiz haqida, “a missing girl”. Uchinchi: narxi o‘n ikki funt, “twelve pounds”. Xaridorning oxirgi gapi “I’ll take it” — men uni olaman, do‘konda qaror qabul qilganda aytiladigan tayyor ibora.
scenes.say: She likes mystery stories. It's about a missing girl. It costs twelve pounds.
scenes.say_uz: U sirli hikoyalarni yoqtiradi. U yo‘qolgan qiz haqida. Uning narxi o‘n ikki funt.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: so‘z urg‘usi

examples.t: My favourite film is a comedy.
She is a famous musician.

scenes.say_native: Janr nomlarining urg‘usi muhim. “Comedy” — birinchi bo‘g‘inda, KO-mi-di. “Romantic” — ikkinchi bo‘g‘inda, ro-MAN-tik. “Documentary” uzun so‘z, urg‘u uchinchi bo‘g‘inda: do-kyu-MEN-tri. “Musician” — mu-ZI-shen, urg‘u ikkinchida. “Favourite” — FEY-vrit, ikki bo‘g‘inli, o‘rtadagi unli deyarli aytilmaydi. “Thriller” — TRIL-e.
scenes.say: Comedy. Romantic. Documentary. Musician. Favourite. Thriller.
scenes.say_uz: Komediya. Romantik. Hujjatli. Musiqachi. Sevimli. Triller.

scenes.title: Fikrni so‘rash
board: What do you think of + noun?

examples.t: What do you think of this song?
examples.uz: Bu qo‘shiq haqida nima deb o‘ylaysiz?

examples.t: Who's your favourite singer?

scenes.say_native: Endi suhbatdoshning fikrini so‘rashni o‘rganamiz. “What do you think of this song?” — bu qo‘shiq haqida nima deb o‘ylaysiz? “What’s it like?” — u qanday, qanaqa? Sevimli narsani so‘rash uchun “Who’s your favourite singer?” yoki “What’s your favourite film?”. Eslatma: odam haqida “who”, narsa haqida “what” ishlatiladi.
scenes.say: What do you think of this song? What's it like? Who's your favourite singer? What's your favourite film?
scenes.say_uz: Bu qo‘shiq haqida nima deb o‘ylaysiz? U qanday? Sevimli xonandangiz kim? Sevimli filmingiz qaysi?

scenes.title: Think of xatosi
board: ✗ How do you think about the film?
✓ What do you think of the film?
✓ What do you think about the film?
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida “film haqida qanday o‘ylaysiz?” deymiz va “qanday” so‘zi “how” bo‘lib ketadi. Ingliz tilida “how do you think” noto‘g‘ri. Mazmun so‘raladi, shuning uchun “what” kerak: “What do you think of the film?” yoki “What do you think about the film?”. Ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri. Javobda esa “How” emas, aynan “I think”
scenes.say: What do you think of the film? What do you think about the book?
scenes.say_uz: Film haqida nima deb o‘ylaysiz? Kitob haqida nima deb o‘ylaysiz?

scenes.title: Bir daqiqalik tavsiya rejasi
scenes.say_native: Endi uy vazifangizga tayyorlanamiz. Bir daqiqalik tavsiya to‘rt qismdan iborat. Birinchi: nomi va janri — “The film is called... It’s a comedy.” Ikkinchi: u nima haqida, hozirgi zamonda. Uchinchi: sizning fikringiz — “I think it’s brilliant.” To‘rtinchi: tavsiya va sabab — “You should watch it because...”.
scenes.say: The film is called Up. It's a cartoon. It's about an old man and a boy. I think it's moving. You should watch it because it's funny and sad.
scenes.say_uz: Film “Up” deb ataladi. Bu multfilm. U keksa odam va bola haqida. Menimcha, u ta’sirli. Uni ko‘rishingiz kerak, chunki u kulgili va qayg‘uli.

scenes.title: O‘z tavsiyangizni ayting
scenes.say_native: Endi navbat sizda. Sevimli film, kitob yoki qo‘shiqni tanlang va tavsiya qiling. To‘rt qismni ketma-ket ayting: nomi va janri, nima haqida, sizning fikringiz, va nima uchun tavsiya qilasiz. Iloji boricha sekin, aniq va to‘liq gaplar bilan gapiring. Xato qilishdan qo‘rqmang, bu mashq.
scenes.say: Now it is your turn. Choose a film, a book or a song. Give the title, say what it is about, say what you think and recommend it.
scenes.say_uz: Endi navbat sizda. Film, kitob yoki qo‘shiq tanlang. Nomini ayting, nima haqida ekanini ayting, fikringizni ayting va tavsiya qiling.

scenes.title: Namuna tavsiya
board: It's called Matilda. It's a children's book.
I recommend it because it's funny.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna. “My book is called Matilda. It’s a children’s book. It’s about a clever girl who loves reading. At the beginning, her family doesn’t like books. Then she finds a kind teacher. I think it’s brilliant. I recommend it because it’s funny and moving.” Ko‘ryapsizmi, hammasi oddiy gaplardan tuzilgan.
scenes.say: It's called Matilda. It's about a clever girl who loves reading. I think it's brilliant. I recommend it because it's funny and moving.
scenes.say_uz: U “Matilda” deb ataladi. U kitob o‘qishni yaxshi ko‘radigan aqlli qiz haqida. Menimcha, u a’lo. Uni tavsiya qilaman, chunki u kulgili va ta’sirli.

scenes.title: Dars xulosasi
board: I think / In my opinion + I agree / I don't agree
You should... / I recommend... / It's about...
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Bugun janrlarni o‘rgandik: kino, musiqa va kitob uchun. Fikr bildirish uchun “I think” va “in my opinion” ni, rozilik uchun “I agree with you” ni ishladik. Tavsiya uchun “You should” va “I recommend”, sabab uchun “because” va “it’s about”. Syujetni hozirgi zamonda, “at the beginning”, “then”, “in the end” bilan aytdik. Va muhim xatolardan qochdik: boring va bored, I agree, recommend watching. Siz juda yaxshi ishladingiz!
scenes.say: Today you learned genres, how to give an opinion, how to recommend and how to tell a simple plot. Great work!
scenes.say_uz: Bugun siz janrlarni, fikr bildirishni, tavsiya berishni va oddiy syujetni aytishni o‘rgandingiz. Ajoyib ish!

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Recommend a film or book in 1 minute
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: bir daqiqa ichida bitta film yoki kitobni tavsiya qiling. Telefoningizga o‘zingizni yozib oling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida sakkizta gap, nomi va janri, nima haqida ekani, sizning fikringiz bilan “I think”, va tavsiya qilish uchun “You should” yoki “I recommend” va sabab. Syujetni hozirgi zamonda ayting. Keyingi darsda pul, narx va savdolashishni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Homework: recommend a film or a book in one minute. See you in the next lesson!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifasi: bir daqiqada film yoki kitobni tavsiya qiling. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: Sevimli film yoki kitobingizni bir daqiqa ichida tavsiya qiling va o‘zingizni yozib oling. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida sakkizta gap; nomi va janri, qisqa syujet (hozirgi zamonda), “I think” bilan fikringiz va “You should” yoki “I recommend” bilan sababli tavsiya.

options: I very much like comedy films to.
I like comedy very much of.
quiz.why_uz: Ingliz tilida “very much” to‘ldiruvchidan keyin turadi: I like comedies very much.

quiz.q: The film is long and nothing happens. I am ___.
quiz.why_uz: His-tuyg‘u uchun “-ed” shakli: I am bored. Film esa boring.
Agree fe’l, uning ortidan with keladi: I agree with you.

quiz.q: Which is the best way to say you don't think the book is good?
options: I think the book isn't good.
I don't think the book is good.
I no think the book is good.
I think the book not good.
quiz.why_uz: Inkor “think” ga qo‘yiladi: I don't think...

options: I recommend you to watch it.
I recommend you watching to it.
quiz.why_uz: “Recommend” dan keyin -ing yoki ot keladi: I recommend watching it.

options: You should to read this novel.
quiz.why_uz: Should dan keyin to‘siz asosiy fe’l: You should read.

quiz.q: Complete the plot: At the beginning, the girl ___ her bag.
quiz.why_uz: Syujet hozirgi zamonda, uchinchi shaxsda -s: she loses.

options: The film tells about a king.
The film is about a king.
The film about is a king.
How do you think about this song?
What do you think of this song?
What you think of this song?
quiz.why_uz: Savol “what” bilan: What do you think of this song?

quiz.q: A film about real animals in Africa is a ___.
quiz.why_uz: Haqiqiy voqealar haqidagi film documentary deyiladi.
